text: How do you think we will communicate in the future, Mai?
I think telepathy might become a reality. We'll be able to send our thoughts directly to someone else's mind.
That sounds like science fiction! I think we will use holography more often.
You mean we'll have 3D images of people when we talk to them?
Exactly. It will feel like they are right in the room with us, even if they are far away.
I think it will be integrated into our glasses or even contact lenses. We won't need to hold a smartphone anymore.
That's amazing but also a bit scary. We might lose real face-to-face contact.
